correctness.rationale: The polynomial reduction commutes with cyclic rotation because (t^3+t+1)^3 divides t^28+1. The four independent binary functionals define a codimension-four preimage. All 512 quotient states partition into 22 exact T-orbits, each with an explicit kernel witness, and an independently executed exact checker verifies every orbit and all state coverage. The union bound excludes codimension five; no asymptotic or sampling inference is involved.
